body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'Surfaces 2009') -- <Visual News> Johnson (www.jfloor.com) demonstrated its prefinished line 'foevertuff' that combines superior wear resistance with an ultra clear elastomeric coating at Surfaces in Las Vegas, from Feb. 3 to 5, 2009.
Their industry exclusive 17 step finishing process produces a smooth and protective finish.
ForeverTuff uses an advanced Resin compound technology that adds resistance in every layer, sustable for commercial and residential use.
